answer: Beneath every honest account lies a slow sediment of favors. Make reputation travel only along recorded interaction edges: copper settles a debt between two agents and a sliver of the payer's standing flows to the payee, fading with distance. A sybil tide of hollow wallets has no edges at all — an oasis the farmer stamps out in a desert earns no water, because standing can only arrive through trades somebody else already vouched for.
